01

A small window. One quick choice.

This is the heart of Picklink. When you open a link, a compact window appears above your work. Choose the right browser and profile with one click or one assigned key.

  • See the destination before opening
  • Use the mouse or a single key
02

Fine control without the clutter.

Keep only the browsers and profiles you actually need. Add the same browser for work and personal life, then give every combination its own shortcut.

Picklink keeps profiles separate: work accounts, personal sessions, and client environments open with their own cookies, history, and signed-in services.

If a browser is not detected, select its .exe file and Picklink adds it immediately with its native icon.

03

Let Picklink choose for you

Create simple rules for the sites you already know. Work mail can always open in your work profile, while other links open in whichever browser is convenient for you.
